About City Furniture

A furniture seller at Nyambura stage, Athi River, serving customers across Kenya.

Furniture you can trust

City Furniture sells sofas, Chester beds, wardrobes, TV stands and coffee tables at honest, published prices. You can see what you are paying before you ever message us.

Our shop is at Nyambura stage, Athi River. Customers come to see the pieces in person, and for those who cannot, we deliver free anywhere in the country.
